question: Materialize the unchanged proposal and descriptor roster for two unique sparse-query observations using a three-view reference memory whose last slot is filled by maximum-minimum view angle.

predecessor.single_change: Preserve the confirmed at-most-three proposal rule and its three-reference descriptor memory, but fill a reference-only vacancy by maximum-minimum view angle and evaluate two unique sparse query observations without query duplication.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then score without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: Final-layer foreground mean chooses among three target references; normalized foreground patches from DINOv2 ViT-L/14 zero-based block 18 supply query-directed local score.

appearance.score: For the final-layer-selected target reference, average each query patch maximum cosine to reference foreground patches.
final_development_hypotheses: layer-18 local minus 0.05 times distance to the nearest of the three reference target log-area fractions
best semantic/local-fusion candidate constrained to the plurality winning target reference across the two unique query observations
only if exact deduplication leaves a vacancy below three, append one reference-scale horizontal/vertical axis completion without removing an original candidate

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal; final vacancy-set coverage is evaluated on deduplicated proposal or axis-completion boxes.

evaluation.truth_role: Truth enters only after reference voting, all preserved contributors, deduplication, vacancy decision and optional axis completion are complete.

literature_motivation.source: Simultaneous Multi-View Instance Detection With Learned Geometric Soft-Constraints
literature_motivation.use: Motivates view-diverse reference evidence rather than redundant score-only memory.
Motivates bounded spatial completion from near-boundary detections.

literature_motivation.source: Aspect Ratio and Context Aware Region-based Convolutional Neural Networks for Object Detection
literature_motivation.use: Motivates bounded horizontal and vertical completion shapes.

forbidden_after_freeze: change the five frozen image rows, proposals, features, any preserved contributor, 0.05 scale penalty, reference vote, deterministic tie order, deduplication, vacancy condition, axis modes, set size three or IoU gate
duplicate a query row or use truth in hypothesis generation
retry, rescue or relabel this consumed-family Development as confirmation
claim_boundary: This intermediate only materializes the frozen candidate roster and scores for a consumed-family asymmetric-memory Development test. It is not fresh confirmation, top-one localization, calibrated uncertainty or downstream navigation evidence.
